name: Embers, Lesser
body:
School evocation [fire]; Level bloodrager 1, magus 1, sorcerer/wizard 1, witch 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (1 piece of burnt wood or charcoal)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 5 rounds + 1 round/level (max 5)
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You cover the target creature with burning embers, dealing 1 fire damage to them at the beginning of their turn. A successful Fortitude save negates the damage for the round. This spell counters a spell of of equal or lower level and is countered by a spell of equal or higher level from the rime group of spells. If the target is affected by a cold or water descriptor spell of the same spell level or higher, this spell ends.
